title: Iron Legion unit type
description: A kind of soldier: stats, equipment, sprites, cost. Files live under content/units/. JSON5 is parsed to JSON before validation; override directives ($override, $delete, $from) are stripped after merging, but are allowed here so a single override object can be checked in isolation.

assetPath.description: Path relative to the mod's assets_root, forward slashes, no '..'.

listOp.description: List override operation. Only valid inside an override object.

$override.description: Override mode when an item with this id already exists. Default merge.

$delete.description: Remove the item with this id from the registry.

$from.description: Copy this existing unit type as the base for a new id, then merge the remaining fields.

deprecated.description: Marks the item deprecated; message names the replacement. Hidden from recruitment.

category.description: Role category. Drives role zones, anti-cavalry rules, and AI considerations.

soldier_radius.description: Collision circle radius in world units.

mass.description: Push weight in collision and charge resolution, in kilograms (Simulation Spec 15.2: infantry about 80, cavalry with horse about 400).

speed_walk.description: Formation walking speed, world units per second.

speed_run.description: Charge and rout speed, world units per second.

speed_march.description: Column and road march speed. Defaults to speed_walk.

armour.description: Flat damage reduction after a hit lands.

attack_interval_ticks.description: Ticks between melee attacks (20 Hz tick).

reach.description: Melee reach from the collision circle edge, world units.

charge_bonus.description: Attack bonus on first contact after a charge.

anti_cavalry_bonus.description: Attack and defence bonus versus cavalry when braced in formation.

second_rank_attack.description: Second rank may attack over the first (spears, pikes).

shield.description: Carries a shield: halves ranged hit chance from the front (combat.shield_mult) and is part of the anti-cavalry brace.

frontal_arc_deg.description: Arc in degrees inside which incoming attacks count as frontal.

ranged.description: Present only for units that shoot.

accuracy.description: Base probability that a projectile lands on its aimed soldier.

projectile_speed.description: Launch speed, world units per second.

arc.description: direct: flat trajectory blocked by friends; indirect: lobbed over friends.

los_radius.description: Line-of-sight radius on flat open ground, world units.

formations.description: Allowed formation templates; the first is the default.

sprite_set.description: Path under assets_root to the 8-facing atlas set.

tier.description: Recruitment tier required from settlement buildings.

experience_tiers.description: Additive bonuses per experience tier, in ascending xp order.
